result:
I'd want to make it so people could more easily recognize when they're being asked to do something that might not actually be in their best interest.

Like, when someone tells you to get a job you hate, or buy something you can't afford, or even just believe something they're telling you - there's often a real cost to that that isn't obvious right away. But if you could actually see it clearly on the other side of your screen, like a little blinking warning light that says "this might be a trap"...

You know what I'm talking about? That moment when you realize someone wanted you to do something that actually harmed them more than you know, but you didn't see it because it was too easy for them to make it look good. It's not that simple stuff doesn't matter, but... what if there was just one more layer of thinking going into things?

But maybe that's exactly how someone would make everything worse, and I've got my own blind spots about all this too. What would you pick instead?
